intro: From our base in Riyadh, we design, manufacture and supply cable management systems for electrical and construction projects.
about: Established in 2022, Osos Al Benaa brings cable trays, ladders, trunking and support accessories together in one practical range. Our manufacturing scope includes brackets, frames and custom fabrication for project-specific requirements.
